title: The Showdown
summary: The Showdown (titled La Resa dei Conti in Italy) was the second gamebook based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, following The City of Atlantis. Written by Frank J. Martucci, it was intended to be published by Fabbri Editori on 1st May, 2010, but was ultimately never released.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.wikitext:
[[Lok]], [[Sophie]] and [[Dante]] are preparing for a dangerous new mission, which will lead them to the gates of [[The Professor's castle|Prague Castle]]. But this time, the end will be decided only by the readers...

The protagonists of Huntik are back in bookstores with a new gamebook, a story that allows players to continue according to their choices, one crossroad after another.

full_text:
The Showdown (titled La Resa dei Conti in Italy) was the second gamebook based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, following The City of Atlantis. Written by Frank J. Martucci, it was intended to be published by Fabbri Editori on 1st May, 2010, but was ultimately never released.

Synopsis

Lok, Sophie and Dante are preparing for a dangerous new mission, which will lead them to the gates of Prague Castle. But this time, the end will be decided only by the readers...

The protagonists of Huntik are back in bookstores with a new gamebook, a story that allows players to continue according to their choices, one crossroad after another.

Trivia

• The book is based on the events of the final episodes of Season 1, The Divine Comedy and The Mission.
